rv.q: The whole ensemble contributes to a thrilling play that both relives history and transcends it.
An unmissable and commanding theatrical tour de force.
This House is a remarkable achievement for all concerned.

cn.t: Graham's enthralling political drama proves timely and pertinent in its West End transfer, offering exuberant insight into the behind-the-scenes workings of the 1974-79 hung Parliament while raising urgent questions about today's system.
